corrections.what: Made the arrow shaft level at y 62.72 and mirrored its arms about it
corrections.why: DR-03 straight lines and symmetry. The arm ends sit 14.6 px either side of the shaft on both sheets.

corrections.what: Drew every stroke at the set line weight W, 5.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03 one line weight. The chair measures 5.25 to 5.75 px; the arrow 6.0 px.

source_notes: Kept: the empty chair with its tall back closed at the bottom, the seat's square arm-top corners, the stem running from the seat line through the foot bar to the same depth as the foot tips, and the detached arrow at seat height with its open gap to the chair (16 px).
